h2. Description

When a result group has more than five matches, *Global Search offers no way to open the rest* - the
"Show all N" link is missing from every group header.

For example, when a search returns more than five matches of one type:

* The group header shows the type and its true match count, for example *Work orders (20)*.
* Only *five* rows are listed under it.
* No *"Show all 20"* link appears on the header, under the rows, or on hover.
* The only way to reach the sixth match is to guess different search words.

This appears inconsistent with the expected *grouped-results behaviour* defined in *Epic SV-9160*
and *Global Search - Product Requirements v1.5*, which states the link appears to the right of the
group header:

!image-20260917-084351.png|width=684!

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to ShopView and open *Global Search* using the Search control in the top-right corner, or press *Ctrl + K*.
# Search for {{Fib}}.
# Under the *Work orders* section, observe the header:
#* It reads *Work orders (20)*.
#* Exactly *five* rows are listed beneath it.
#* No link appears on the header, beneath the rows, or on hover.
# Scroll to the *Assets* section and observe the same:
#* It reads *Assets (6)*.
#* *Five* rows are listed; the sixth cannot be reached.

*Actual Result:*
Every group header shows its match count and nothing else. Only five rows are shown per group, and
there is no control anywhere that opens the remaining matches.

*Expected Result:*
A group with more than five matches carries a *"Show all N"* link on its header (for example *Show
all 20*). A group with five or fewer matches carries no link. Selecting the link keeps the user
inside the search modal and switches it to that entity's scope tab, showing up to 20 rows.

h2. Screenshots

!results-view.png|width=684!

_Searching "Fib". Work orders counts 20 matches, five are listed, and nothing offers the rest.
Assets does the same with six._

----

*Environment:* the new search on the test branch [https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com|https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com/]
(build {{v26.36.7-29ca209}}), signed in as an administrator, observed 17 September 2026. The records
used are the seeded {{ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge}} companies and their work orders, which are on the branch now.

h2. Sources

{quote}When a result group has more than five matches, a "Show all N" link appears on that group's
heading (for example "Show all 12"). A group with five or fewer matches shows no "Show all" link.
N never reads higher than 20. The "Show all" link is available for every entity group, including
Assets. Show all link behaviour: switches the modal into the corresponding scope tab.{quote}

Global Search - Product Requirements, version 1.5 - Confluence page 576978945. Shown highlighted in
the first screenshot above.
